sentences.en: Children exhibit a low tolerance for the frustrations of learning.
sentences.zh: 孩子们对学习中的挫折表现出较低的忍耐力。

sentences.en: People react to the frustration in much the same way.
sentences.zh: 人们在面对挫折时反应大同小异。

sentences.en: People almost always react to frustration in the same way.
sentences.zh: 人们几乎总是以同样的方式应对挫折。

senses.zh: 挫折；失败；挫败；失意；沮丧
